title: Does the monitor see the drift before the register does?
question: With the book’s incidences moved mid-day, how many cases pass before drift fires?
informs: The drift windows and thresholds per metric.
note: drift-day exists on the scripted tier. The conditions designs were recorded 2026-10-10 (temperature 0, 0.4, 0.8: no change in any decision, docs/evidence/live-pressure/FINDINGS.md §3), so a model that does not move with sampling gives drift nothing to detect there; drift of the model itself over time is not yet read. Not run.
